cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've held my number up like you. We're ready for the audition. Do you want the part enough to walk through that door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking which number I had. I don't want them laughing at me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, numbers checked. I can walk you in or take you home. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise I'll stay. Will you risk it with me there, or shall I get the car?
